title: ModuleNamespace
description: Policy for one user-module namespace: portable per-subject summaries and preferences stored by OpenVibe.Network. Never domain truth, money or authoritative game inventory (roadmap 4.3-4.5). The person's account decides what happens to their records in every namespace: when an account is removed, Network deletes all of its records; when two accounts are merged, the surviving account keeps its own record in a namespace where both have one (the other is deleted), and a record only the absorbed account had moves to the survivor. Each of these changes is announced as network.module.updated (reason subject_removed or subject_merged). That is separate from onOwnerRemoved, which says what happens to a namespace's records when the service that owns the namespace is retired.

owner.description: Service that owns the namespace and may write it with network.modules.write.

version.description: Schema version stored with every record; a change needs a migration note.

schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) every stored value must satisfy.

writers.description: owner = the owning service with a token; user = the subject themselves.

publicFields.description: Top-level fields anyone may read. Everything else is readable only by the subject and granted services.

onOwnerRemoved.description: What happens to records when the owning service or mod is retired.

migration.description: How records of the previous version are upgraded.
